consequence.statement: The old encryption.{keyFile,mountPath,secretName,interface} Helm options are removed and no longer honored; encryption must be configured via encryption.ipsec.* options instead.

original.statement: Deprecated Helm options encryption.{keyFile,mountPath,secretName,interface} are removed in Cilium 1.16.0 and replaced by encryption.ipsec.* options.

decision.reason: [ev-5d3c6d3080f0] says the deprecated Helm options encryption.{keyFile,mountPath,secretName,interface} are removed in favor of encryption.ipsec.*. A removed values key means any value still set under the old name is no longer honoured, which fits setting-ignored (removed/renamed key). The validators also confirm that encryption.keyFile is absent from the target values [ev-28e0ccb5774a, ev-39a22d88e2f5]. The proposed statement stays within the evidence: the old keys are no longer honoured and encryption must be configured through encryption.ipsec.*.
